projectiles.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Game-ready 2D chibi fantasy combat VFX atlas. Render six discrete full color hand-drawn game effects centered in a strictly regular invisible 3-column by 2-row grid, each fits completely inside its own cell with generous 10% transparent gutters. True RGBA transparency and luminous accents isolated from the canvas, dark saturated contrast at small size, simple large silhouettes no background shadows, no text, no characters, no marks or frames, no UI. Slightly elevated game camera.
In reading order:
1. one lime-green and purple poison glob with broad damp taper, points to screen-right, a few attached droplets, no bottle.
2. one amber and crimson flame orb with compact hot-white center and attached long fire trail to left, points right.
3. one cyan frost icicle shard with short wispy trail to left, sharp readable silhouette, points right.
4. one blood-red ruby projectile like a compact red liquid sphere with one comet tail to left, points to right.
5. one glowing violet and off-white shadow magic bolt with compact irregular shard and trail to left, points right.
6. one straight wooden brown fletched arrow with pale steel point to the right.
Unlisted cells fully transparent.
